title: LB Liquid Medium Preparation
author: Katy M Monteith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p4vdqw6

steps.title: Prepare LB Broth Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine LB broth (Miller) with distilled water and mix until dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 grams of LB broth, Miller per litre of distilled H₂O.
Mix well by inverting the bottle several times until the powder is dissolved.

steps.title: Sterilize Medium
steps.instruction: Autoclave the medium and handle under sterile conditions.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize by autoclaving for 20 min at 15 psi (1.05 kg/cm2) on the liquid cycle.
Open and use the LB broth only within a laminar flow hood to prevent contamination.

steps.title: Cool Medium
steps.instruction: Allow the LB broth to cool to room temperature before use.
